written_after_exposure.declaration: THIS AMENDMENT WAS WRITTEN AFTER P1-P9 EXPOSURE
written_after_exposure.p9_verdict_unchanged: P9 remains FAIL in MASSIVE_1M_PROBE_EXECUTION_STAGE_B_V1; this amendment settles downstream policy, not that verdict
written_after_exposure.naming_discipline: the bar is called SESSION_CLOSE_BOUNDARY_BAR and NOT CLOSE_AUCTION_BAR. P4 was INDICATIVE ONLY and its 5x threshold was met by both the 15:59 and the 16:00 bar, so the auction reading is plausible and undemonstrated. A canonical name asserting a mechanism would convert an unproven reading into an inherited fact.

boundary_bar.name_rationale: describes the bar's POSITION, which is observed, not its CAUSE, which P4 did not establish

stability_assertions: A: a bar stamped exactly at the session close exists for every (symbol, session)
B: the count of REGULAR minutes equals 390 on a normal session and 210 on an early close, for these liquid symbols
C: the boundary bar's volume exceeds 5x the median volume of the preceding 30 regular minutes
frozen_rule.verdict_rule: STABLE only if A, B and C hold for every (symbol, session) combination; otherwise UNSTABLE

downstream_policy.not_a_regular_minute: the boundary bar is NOT a 391st or 211th regular minute; under BAR_START labelling it begins AT the close
downstream_policy.preservation: preserved separately and never silently dropped
downstream_policy.higher_tf: included in the FINAL session bucket as an explicit endpoint component, declared rather than absorbed
downstream_policy.why: counting it as an extra minute would inflate every per-minute denominator by one and shift every RVOL baseline downward
